source_name: 各项目员工工作内容梳理 (1).docx

arts.intro: 入门套路（Beginner Form）——熊猫 Pongda

moves.chinese_action: 并步站直，身体直立，双脚分开大约三个半脚掌的距离。脚尖朝前，缓慢下蹲至大腿与地面平行
moves.english_action: Stand upright with your feet together. Separate your feet to about three and a half foot-widths apart, with your toes pointing forward. Slowly lower your body into a horse stance until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
moves.chinese_coaching: 双脚脚尖朝前，大腿与地面平行。膝盖不要超过脚尖，身体直立向后坐。
moves.english_coaching: Keep both feet pointing straight forward, with your thighs parallel to the ground. Do not let your knees extend past your toes. Keep your torso upright and sit your hips back

moves.chinese_action:
左脚向前一大步，大约 4-5 倍脚长。前脚尖​
微微内扣，屈膝半蹲，大腿成水平，小腿垂直于地面，后脚脚心着地，膝盖绷直。
moves.english_action: Step forward with your left foot about four to five foot lengths. Turn your front toes slightly inward. Bend your front knee into a half squat until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, with your front shin perpendicular to the floor. Keep your back foot flat on the ground with the sole fully planted, and keep your back leg straight with the knee fully extended.
moves.chinese_coaching: 前大腿与地面平行，膝盖不要超过脚尖，前小腿垂直于地面，后腿膝盖崩直，脚心着地
moves.english_coaching: Keep your front thigh parallel to the ground. Do not let your front knee extend past your toes. Keep your front shin perpendicular to the floor. Fully straighten your back knee and keep the entire sole of your back foot firmly planted on the ground.

moves.chinese_action: 双脚打开成马步，双拳抱腰间，拳从腰间往前冲出，另一只手抱于腰间。换手冲拳的时候出拳同时收另一只拳。
moves.english_action: Open your feet into a horse stance with both fists chambered at the waist. Drive one fist straight forward from the waist while keeping the other fist chambered at the waist. As you switch sides, retract the extended fist back to the waist at the exact same time the opposite fist punches straight forward. Keep the movements synchronized, with one fist extending as the other returns.
moves.chinese_coaching: 冲拳的高度与地面平行，冲拳的时候另一只拳回事收抱于腰间。
moves.english_coaching: Keep the punching fist parallel to the ground. As one fist punches straight forward, simultaneously retract the opposite fist back to the waist into the chamber position.

moves.chinese_action: 站马步。双拳抱腰，拳心向上。后脚蹬地转腰身体变弓步。
moves.english_action: Start in a horse stance with both fists chambered at the waist, palms facing upward. Push off the back foot, rotate your waist, and transition into a bow stance.
moves.chinese_coaching: 身体不要高低起伏，始终保持同一高度。
moves.english_coaching: Keep your body at the same height throughout the movement. Avoid any up-and-down motion.

moves.chinese_action: 站弓步，双脚和身体旋转变马步。
moves.english_action: Start in a bow stance. Rotate both feet and your torso simultaneously to transition smoothly into a horse stance.
moves.chinese_coaching: 身体不要高低起伏，重心始终保持于双腿之间。
moves.english_coaching: Keep your body at a constant height throughout movement. Maintain your center of gravity evenly between both legs at all times.

moves.english_name: Horse Stance to Bow Stance with Straight Punch
moves.chinese_action: 站马步，马步转弓步的时候同时从腰间出拳向前冲。哪只脚蹬地出哪个拳。
moves.english_action: Start in a horse stance with both fists chambered at the waist. As you transition into a bow stance, punch straight forward from the waist at the same time. Punch with the fist on the same side as the leg that drives off the ground.
moves.chinese_coaching: 步伐完成的时候拳也冲到。
moves.english_coaching: The punch should reach full extension at the exact moment the footwork is completed.

arts.intro: 套路简介：灵巧，飘逸，掌法为主——猴子——Wongkey

moves.chinese_action: 双手腰间抱拳，身体斜 45 度四六步推按掌。掌为立掌，左掌掌心朝内，肘关节微曲。右手向下按掌，置于丹田的高度。
moves.english_action: Begin with both fists chambered at the waist. Turn your body 45 degrees into a 60/40 stance (cat stance). Extend the left palm forward into a vertical palm, with the palm facing inward and the elbow slightly bent. Simultaneously press the right palm downward to the level of the lower abdomen (dantian), keeping the palm relaxed and the elbow naturally bent.
moves.chinese_coaching: 很好，步伐蹲下去。注意手掌的高度，双眼平视前方，双掌像控制着两头凶猛的野兽
moves.english_coaching: Good. Sink deeper into the stance. Pay close attention to the height of both palms. Keep your eyes looking straight ahead. Imagine your two palms are controlling two fierce beasts, maintaining steady pressure and complete control.

moves.chinese_action: 左脚往回并步，脚后跟不落地，脚尖踮起。收脚的同时左手变拳抱回腰间，右手翻腕从下往上撩。到与下巴平齐的高度停止。上左步，右掌变拳收回腰间同时变马步推出左掌。手臂与肩形成水平高度。
moves.english_action: Draw your left foot back into a closing stance, keeping the heel lifted and balancing on the ball of the foot. At the same time, retract your left hand into a fist and chamber it at the waist. Rotate your right wrist and sweep the right palm upward from below, stopping when it reaches chin height. Then step forward with your left foot into a horse stance. Simultaneously, retract the right hand into a fist and chamber it at the waist while pushing the left palm straight forward. Keep the left arm level with the shoulder, forming a straight horizontal line.
moves.chinese_coaching: 左脚脚后跟不要落地，上步推掌的时候要快速！
moves.english_coaching: Keep your left heel off the ground. Explode into the forward step and execute the palm strike quickly.

moves.chinese_action: 马步变弓步，左掌变拳收回腰间同时右拳变掌往前撩掌，到鼻尖的高度成立掌迅速收于腰间，弓步变马步。再变弓步右掌向前推出
moves.english_action: Transition from a horse stance into a bow stance. As you move, retract your left palm into a fist and chamber it at the waist. At the same time, rotate your right fist into an open palm and sweep it upward in front of your body, stopping at nose height in a vertical palm position. Immediately retract the right palm back to the waist. Then transition from the bow stance back into a horse stance, and smoothly shift into a bow stance again while driving the right palm straight forward in a palm strike.
moves.chinese_coaching: 动作衔接要快，步伐变换不能乱，别着急，慢慢来。
moves.english_coaching: Keep the transitions between movements quick and smooth. Maintain clean footwork without losing your balance. Don't rush—move with control and take your time.

moves.chinese_action: 右掌与肘关节向外旋转，架与头顶，左掌立掌置于右胸前。同时左脚向后插，形成右脚在前的交叉步。
moves.english_action: Rotate the right palm and elbow outward, lifting the arm into an overhead guarding position. Keep the left palm upright in front of the right chest. Step the left foot backward and cross it behind the right foot, forming a crossed stance with the right foot leading.
moves.chinese_coaching: 右掌架在头顶格挡！左手护在胸前！
moves.english_coaching: Raise the right palm above the head to form an overhead block. Keep the left hand guarding in front of the chest.

moves.chinese_action: 上左脚同时向上抡臂拍掌，左手心拍右手背。同时起右脚，拍掌后连贯右手击打后脚背。右脚落在左脚前顺势转身推右掌，步伐变左弓步，退左脚推出左掌，步伐变为右弓步。掌为立掌，另一只手握拳抱于腰间。
moves.english_action:
Step forward with the left foot while swinging the arm upward into a clapping motion, striking the back of the right hand with the left palm. At the same time, lift the right leg and, immediately after the clap, strike the instep of the raised right foot with the right hand.
Land the right foot in front of the left foot and smoothly turn the body while pushing forward with the right palm. Transition into a left bow stance. Step the left foot back and extend the left palm forward, shifting into a right bow stance.
Keep the striking hand in an upright palm position, while the other hand forms a fist and is held at the waist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 落地后马上转身推掌！衔接要快
moves.english_coaching: Immediately turn the body and push the palm forward as soon as the foot lands. The transition should be quick and continuous.

moves.chinese_action: 上左脚同时双臂由下往上从左往右成圆形摆动，右掌立与右水平高度，左掌架与右胸前。双手臂摆动时较直。右脚上步同时重心靠左，右脚成交叉步落在左脚左前方。
moves.english_action:
Step forward with the left foot while swinging both arms upward from low to high in a circular motion from left to right. Keep the right palm upright at shoulder level on the right side, while the left palm guards in front of the right chest. Keep both arms relatively straight during the circular swing.
Step forward with the right foot while shifting the weight toward the left leg. Place the right foot diagonally in front of the left foot, forming a crossed stance.
moves.chinese_coaching: 摆掌的时候手要直！当心脚不要叉错！
moves.english_coaching: Keep both arms straight during the palm-swinging motion. Be careful not to cross your feet incorrectly when stepping.

moves.chinese_action: 身体前倾，双臂张开，身体 360 度翻身旋转。
moves.english_action: Lean the body forward, extend both arms outward, and perform a 360-degree spinning turn.
moves.chinese_coaching: 旋转的时候手臂要伸直，记住左手先动！
moves.english_coaching: Keep both arms fully extended during the spin. Remember, the left hand initiates the movement first.

moves.chinese_action: 翻身后右腿顺势朝上侧踢腿，左手向上架掌，右手护于左胸前。
moves.english_action: After completing the turn, use the momentum to perform an upward side kick with the right leg. Raise the left palm to guard overhead, while the right hand protects in front of the left chest.
moves.chinese_coaching: 腿从侧面往上踢！记住双掌的位置！
moves.english_coaching: Kick the leg upward from the side. Remember to maintain the correct position of both palms.

moves.chinese_action: 脚顺势落地之后双手朝身后向下摆掌，掌心朝下。提左膝亮掌，左掌置于右胸前，右掌置于额前斜上方。。
moves.english_action: After the foot lands naturally, swing both hands downward and backward behind the body, with the palms facing down. Lift the left knee and perform a palm display posture: place the left palm in front of the right chest, and position the right palm diagonally upward in front of the forehead.
moves.chinese_coaching: 记得朝你摆掌的方向看！提膝的时候脚背要绷直！
moves.english_coaching: Remember to look toward the direction of the palm swing. When lifting the knee, keep the instep fully extended and the toes pointed.

moves.chinese_action: 落脚并步双掌从下往上沿两侧画半圆，置最高点向下缓慢按掌收式。
moves.english_action: Step down and bring our feet together. Sweep both palms upward from low to high, drawing semicircular arcs along both sides of the body. At the highest point, slowly press both palms downward to complete the closing posture.
moves.chinese_coaching: 别忘记吐气！
moves.english_coaching: Remember to exhale during the movement.

arts.intro: 套路简介：刚猛，简洁，讲究以气御力——熊——Boor

moves.chinese_action: 马步扎下，双手为拳抱于腰间，手臂向左侧格挡。右手抱拳与腰间
moves.english_action: Sink into a horse stance. Form both hands into fists and chamber them at the waist. Block to the left side with the arm, while keeping the right fist chambered at the waist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 左拳记得不要离自己太近！马步扎下去！
moves.english_coaching: Remember to keep the left fist at the proper distance from the body. Sink deeper into the horse stance.

moves.chinese_action: 左弓步冲拳，左拳抱于腰间，右手冲拳。手臂与地面平行
moves.english_action: Step into a left bow stance and punch forward with the right fist. Keep the left fist chambered at the waist. The punching arm should be parallel to the ground.
moves.chinese_coaching: 记住蹬地！转要腰出拳
moves.english_coaching: Remember to push off the ground, rotate the waist, and drive the punch forward with the power of the body rotation.

moves.chinese_action: 提右膝时右拳回收于腰间，弹腿冲左拳。
moves.english_action: Lift the right knee while retracting the right fist back to the waist. Then perform a front snap kick with the right leg while punching forward with the left fist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 收拳的同时出拳！记得弹腿要收回来！
moves.english_coaching: Retract one fist while simultaneously punching with the other. Remember to snap the kicking leg back after the kick.

moves.chinese_action: 右脚后撤落左脚后面成左弓步冲拳
moves.english_action: Step the right foot backward and place it behind the left foot, forming a left bow stance while punching forward.
moves.chinese_coaching: 脚直接落到后面！落脚的同时出拳
moves.english_coaching: Step the right foot directly back and land behind the left foot. Punch forward at the same moment the foot lands.

moves.chinese_action: 左弓步变马步右拳变掌架于头顶，左拳冲出
moves.english_action: Transition from a left bow stance into a horse stance. Change the right fist into a palm and raise it above the head as a guard, while punching forward with the left fist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 马步变换要快！架掌和冲拳同时到位！
moves.english_coaching: Switch into the horse stance quickly. The overhead palm guard and the forward punch must land at the same time.

moves.chinese_action: 身体右转盖掌，右脚回收点地。脚尖抬起，两脚间距 10cm
moves.english_action: Turn the body to the right and perform a downward covering palm. Retract the right foot and lightly touch the ground. Keep the toes lifted, with approximately 10 cm between both feet.
moves.chinese_coaching: 盖掌准备出拳！
moves.english_coaching: After the covering palm, prepare immediately for the punch.

moves.chinese_action: 上右脚马步右冲拳
moves.english_action: Step forward with the right foot into a horse stance, then punch forward with the right fist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 马步冲右拳！
moves.english_coaching: Horse stance with a right punch.

moves.chinese_action: 翻腕盖右掌跺脚，头朝后下方看。左拳抱于腰间。
moves.english_action: Rotate the wrist and perform a downward covering motion with the right palm while stomping the foot. Turn the head to look backward and downward. Keep the left fist chambered at the waist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 注意手腕上的动作！
moves.english_coaching: Pay attention to wrist movement. Ensure the wrist rotation is clear and controlled during the palm-covering motion.

moves.chinese_action: 右手变拳顺势举高，左手变掌砸拳
moves.english_action: Change the right hand into a fist and raise it upward with the momentum. At the same time, change the left hand into a palm and strike down onto the fist.
moves.chinese_coaching: 砸拳落于丹田的位置！
moves.english_coaching: The downward fist strike should land at the position of the Dantian (lower abdomen).

moves.chinese_action: 双手变掌由下往上至最高点缓慢下按
moves.english_action: Change both hands into palms, raise them upward from low to high, then slowly press downward from the highest point.
moves.chinese_coaching: 缓慢吐气！
moves.english_coaching: Exhale slowly.

arts.intro: 套路简介：刚柔并济，讲究呼吸，缓慢——水豚——Bara

moves.chinese_action: 双脚分开与肩同宽，双掌掌心朝下。从下往上至与地面平行后，缓慢下按
moves.english_action: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Keep both palms facing downward. Raise both palms upward from low to high until they are parallel to the ground, then slowly press them downward.
moves.chinese_coaching: 感受“气”它无处不在。
moves.english_coaching: Feel the “Qi” (energy) — it is present everywhere.

moves.chinese_action: 右抱球，左脚前方上步，右手按左手捋，左野马分鬓
moves.english_action: Hold an imaginary ball on the right side. Step forward with the left foot, then use the right hand to press while the left hand performs a pulling motion. Execute the Left Wild Horse Parts Its Mane movement.
moves.chinese_coaching: 注意双手的位置，用双手控制“气”
moves.english_coaching: Pay attention to the position of both hands. Use your hands to guide and control the “Qi” (energy).

moves.chinese_action: 左手抱球，上右步。左手按右手捋。
moves.english_action: Hold an imaginary ball on the left side. Step forward with the right foot. Use the left hand to press while the right hand performs a pulling motion.
moves.chinese_coaching: 眼睛盯住你的前手！
moves.english_coaching: Keep your eyes focused on your leading hand.

moves.chinese_action: 左手掌心朝上，往右手走，右手掌心朝下，左手到右手手腕位置后双手往下捋。到丹田的位置左手按住右手手腕往前推。画个小圆右手变勾手，左手往左推掌
moves.english_action:
With the left palm facing upward, move it toward the right hand. Keep the right palm facing downward. When the left hand reaches the right wrist, both hands perform a downward pulling motion.
Bring the hands down to the Dantian (lower abdomen) level. The left hand presses against the right wrist, then push both hands forward. Draw a small circle with the movement, change the right hand into a hook hand, and push the left palm outward to the left side.
moves.chinese_coaching: 注意双手和脚步的变化！推掌的时候眼睛看向左手！
moves.english_coaching: Pay attention to the changes in both hand positions and footwork. When pushing the palm, look toward the left hand.

moves.chinese_action: 双手往右带，往上带变立掌，手推琵琶。
moves.english_action: Guide both hands to the right and lift them upward, transitioning into upright palms. Perform the Playing the Pipa posture.
moves.chinese_coaching: 注意手腕的变化，像抱着琵琶一样！
moves.english_coaching: Pay attention to the wrist movements. Shape your hands as if you are holding a pipa (Chinese lute).

moves.chinese_action: 身体左转，左手在上抱球，白鹤亮翅。
moves.english_action: Turn the body to the left. Hold an imaginary ball with the left hand above, then perform the White Crane Spreads Its Wings posture.
moves.chinese_coaching: 胸要打开，背要直，左脚脚尖点地！
moves.english_coaching: Open the chest, keep the back straight, and lightly touch the ground with the toes of the left foot.

moves.chinese_action: 左手翻掌往上走，右手从左肘关节往下按，变右手抬左手往下按，上左步右手从右耳后推出，左手搂膝盖按在左边。重心后移做另一边搂膝拗步
moves.english_action:
Turn the left palm upward and lift it. The right hand presses downward from the left elbow area. Then switch the movement: raise the right hand while pressing the left hand downward.
Step forward with the left foot. Push the right palm forward from behind the right ear, while the left hand circles around and presses down beside the left knee. Shift the weight backward, then perform the Brush Knee and Twist Step movement on the opposite side.
moves.chinese_coaching: 先别着急，看清楚手上的动作！注意右手从耳朵后面推出！
moves.english_coaching: Don’t rush. Make sure you clearly follow the hand movements. Pay attention to the right hand — it pushes forward from behind the ear.

moves.chinese_action: 左手往身后走，掌心朝上往上撩，至于肩平行后往前推，右手往上撩后收回腰间腿前脚。
moves.english_action:
Move the left hand backward with the palm facing upward, then lift it in an upward scooping motion. When the hand reaches shoulder height, push it forward.
Raise the right hand upward in a scooping motion, then retract it to the waist while stepping forward with the front leg.
moves.chinese_coaching: 眼睛看后面的那只手！注意步伐的协调！
moves.english_coaching: Keep your eyes on the hand behind you. Pay attention to the coordination between the hand movements and the footwork.

moves.chinese_action: 双手掌心于丹田处抱球往上推，身体右转掌心开合之后右弓步分掌
moves.english_action: Hold an imaginary ball with both palms at the Dantian level and push it upward. Turn the body to the right, open and close the palms, then step into a right bow stance and separate the palms.
moves.chinese_coaching: 感受“气”在你手心挤压！
moves.english_coaching: Feel the “Qi” (energy) being compressed between your palms.

moves.chinese_action: 双手画圆，左手在上右手在下的时候往中间收，右掌朝上，左掌按右肘关节，金刚倒槌。画圆收式
moves.english_action: Circle both hands. When the left hand is above and the right hand is below, draw them inward toward the center. Turn the right palm upward, while the left palm presses against the right elbow joint. Perform the Buddha’s Warrior Pounds the Mortar movement. Finish by drawing a circle and returning to the closing posture.
moves.chinese_coaching: 震脚的时候吐气！收式的时候手往上时吸气，手往下时吐气。
moves.english_coaching: Exhale when stomping the foot. During the closing posture, inhale as the hands rise and exhale as the hands press downward.

arts.intro: 套路简介：变换，身法，讲究连绵不绝——鹤——cryn

moves.chinese_action: 双掌从两侧往上，至最高点往下按掌
moves.english_action: Raise both palms upward from both sides of the body. At the highest point, press both palms downward.
moves.chinese_coaching: 双手下按的时候吐出身体里的浊气
moves.english_coaching: Exhale and release the stale energy from the body as you press both hands downward.

moves.chinese_action: 双掌从腰间往后走，背掌往前交叉于头顶，分掌双掌掌心朝天从两侧往中间走
moves.english_action: Move both palms backward from the waist. Turn the backs of the hands forward and cross them above the head. Then separate the palms, with both palms facing upward, and draw them inward from both sides toward the center.
moves.chinese_coaching: 想象掌心托着东西！
moves.english_coaching: Imagine your palms supporting an object. Keep the palms stable and maintain the feeling of holding something in your hands.

moves.chinese_name: 左闭门掩肘，行步撩衣，插花掖肋
moves.chinese_action: 右掌抱于右腰间，左肘往右移动。左手由下往上由右往左画圆，掌心朝外。手臂伸直立于与肩平行。右掌往前插左手从头上往后画圆。后掌盖掌从头上过
moves.english_action:
Keep the right palm chambered at the right waist. Move the left elbow toward the right side. Circle the left hand from low to high and from right to left, with the palm facing outward. Extend the arm straight until it reaches shoulder height.
Thrust the right palm forward while the left hand circles backward over the head. Then perform a covering palm motion, bringing the rear palm over and across the top of the head.
moves.chinese_coaching: 双脚不动，身体跟着双掌旋转！
moves.english_coaching: Keep both feet stationary. Rotate the body following the movement of both palms.

moves.chinese_name: 右闭门掩肘，行步撩衣，插花掖肋
moves.chinese_action: 左掌抱于左腰间，右肘往左移动。右手由下往上由左往右画圆，掌心朝外。手臂伸直立于与肩平行。左掌往前插左手从头上往后画圆。后掌盖掌从头上过
moves.english_action:
Keep the left palm chambered at the left waist. Move the right elbow toward the left side. Circle the right hand from low to high and from left to right, with the palm facing outward. Extend the arm straight until it reaches shoulder height.
Thrust the left palm forward while the right hand circles backward over the head. Then perform a covering palm motion, bringing the rear palm over and across the top of the head.
moves.chinese_coaching: 先稳步法；动作连贯；不要抢动作；很好，继续。
moves.english_coaching: First stabilize your footwork. Keep the movements smooth and connected. Don’t rush the tec   hniques. Good, keep going.

moves.chinese_name: 右侧横向闭门掩肘，行步撩衣，插花掖类
moves.chinese_action: 右手从左手手背穿掌后。左掌抱于左腰间，右肘往后移动。右手由下往上由后往前画圆，掌心朝外。手臂伸直立于与肩平行。左掌往前插右手从头上往后画圆。后掌盖掌从头上过
moves.english_action:
After the right hand threads through above the back of the left hand, chamber the left palm at the left waist. Move the right elbow backward. Circle the right hand from low to high and from back to front, with the palm facing outward. Extend the arm straight until it reaches shoulder height.
Thrust the left palm forward while the right hand circles backward over the head. Then perform a covering palm motion, bringing the rear palm over and across the top of the head.
moves.chinese_coaching: 动作连贯；不要抢动作；很好，继续。
moves.english_coaching: Keep the movements smooth and connected. Don’t rush the techniques. Good, keep going.

moves.chinese_name: 左侧横向闭门掩肘，行步撩衣，插花掖类
moves.chinese_action: 右掌抱于右腰间，左肘往后移动。左手由下往上由后往前画圆，掌心朝外。手臂伸直立于与肩平行。右掌往前插左手从头上往后画圆。后掌盖掌从头上过
moves.english_action:
Keep the right palm chambered at the right waist. Move the left elbow backward. Circle the left hand from low to high and from back to front, with the palm facing outward. Extend the arm straight until it reaches shoulder height.
Thrust the right palm forward while the left hand circles backward over the head. Then perform a covering palm motion, bringing the rear palm over and across the top of the head.
moves.chinese_coaching: 你已经掌握很多了！
moves.english_coaching: You have already mastered a lot of techniques!

moves.chinese_action: 左掌从右手背后穿掌，双掌变立掌
moves.english_action: Thread the left palm through behind the back of the right hand, then transition both palms into upright palm positions.
moves.chinese_coaching: 记住，左掌在前。
moves.english_coaching: Remember, the left palm should be positioned in front.

moves.chinese_action: 往右片旋掌，右掌从下往上从前向后从头上过，左掌从前往后从头上过
moves.english_action: Rotate the palms to the right. Move the right palm from low to high, then from front to back, passing over the head. At the same time, move the left palm from front to back, also passing over the head.
moves.chinese_coaching: 别着急，慢慢来。
moves.english_coaching: Don’t rush. Take it slowly.

moves.chinese_name: 叶底藏花 鸿雁出群
moves.chinese_action: 右掌藏于左腋下身体上半身后转，右手从左肘往前走。身体右转鸿雁出群
moves.english_action: Hide the right palm under the left armpit and rotate the upper body backward. Move the right hand forward from the left elbow area. Turn the body to the right and perform the Wild Geese Emerging from the Flock movement.
moves.chinese_coaching: 左掌立于右手肘尖的位置！身体转向右边
moves.english_coaching: Place the left palm upright at the tip of the right elbow. Turn the body to the right side.

moves.chinese_action: 双掌交叉合于胸前双手往下按。
moves.english_action: Cross both palms together in front of the chest, then press both hands downward.
moves.chinese_coaching: 手往下的时候记得吐气！
moves.english_coaching: Remember to exhale as your hands move downward.
